indication_area: Generalized myasthenia gravis (anti-AChR antibody positive adults)
annual_basis: Calendar years 2024 and 2025 from UCB's annual reports (table 'Net sales by product', worldwide, EUR million); 2023 is printed as 0 in the 2024 report and is not recorded as a row.

approval_evidence.quote: ZILBRYSQ (zilucoplan) injection, for subcutaneous use. Initial U.S. Approval: 2023 ... ZILBRYSQ is a complement inhibitor indicated for the treatment of generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) in adult patients who are anti-acetylcholine receptor (AChR) antibody positive. Revised: 10/2023

notes: Series begins in 2024 because the 2024 annual report prints the 2023 figure as 0 (US approval October 2023; no Zilbrysq net-sales line was found in the 2023 annual report). Worldwide sum of regions in the geographic table of the same reports: 2024 U.S. 56 + Europe 8 + Japan 8 = 72; 2025 U.S. 157 + Europe 35 + Japan 24 = 216 against 217 printed (International markets and rounding; the product table is the one recorded). Half-year figures exist (H1 2025 93, H1 2024 15 in the half-year report) but UCB prints no quarterly product net sales, so no quarterly series is built. Reported in EUR; no USD conversion applied.

no_quarterly_series.source_quote: UCB half-year report 2025, Top product net sales, EUR million, six months ended June 30 | ZILBRYSQ® 93 15 >100% >100%
no_quarterly_series.details: UCB publishes product net sales only in half-year and annual reports; its download centre lists no Q1 or Q3 report, and the HY26 Excel file gives six-month figures (ZILBRYSQ 139.3 EUR million H1 2026, 93.3 H1 2025). Half-years cannot be split into quarters with gold's derivations. Quarters are not interpolated.

search_log: Downloaded UCB's FY2023, FY2024 and FY2025 integrated annual reports and the 2025 half-year report and extracted every line naming ZILBRYSQ/zilucoplan (work/ucb.py). FY2023 report: launch text only, no net-sales line. FY2024 report: product table 72 (2023: 0). FY2025 report: 217 (2024: 72); regional table lines agree (U.S. 157, Europe 35, Japan 24 in 2025).
Half-year 2025 report prints ZILBRYSQ 93 for H1 2025 against 15 for H1 2024.
Searched Bigdata.com for UCB nine-month / third-quarter 2025 Zilbrysq net sales: no quarterly or nine-month product document found.
Did not check the FY2022 or earlier reports (no product before 2023) or the half-year 2024 report URL.

Rechecked here: UCB's download centre lists only half-year and full-year reports (HY26 documents: slides, transcript, press release, half-year report, Excel file, facts and figures); there is no first- or third-quarter report. The HY26 Excel file (sheet 'Net Sales - Prod', columns 2026 and 2025, six months) prints ZILBRYSQ® 139,272,605 against 93,332,113 EUR; no quarter is printed.

Earlier owner: Ra Pharmaceuticals (acquired by UCB; its SEC filings predate the 2023 approval); full-text search for 'zilucoplan' and 'Zilbrysq' finds Ra's pre-approval filings and competitors (Immunovant, Dianthus, argenx, Apellis), no sales figure.
Half-year-only reporting cannot give quarters, so the annual series is kept. 2026 is not complete and is not added.
